versions.content: When the Rx buffer is large enough for the next block (directly after the First Frame or the last Consecutive Frame of a block, or after repeated calls to PduR_CanTpCopyRxData () according to [SWS_CanTp_00222]), the CanTp module shall send a Flow Control N-PDU with ClearToSend status ( FC(CTS) ) and shall then expect the reception of Consecutive Frame N-PDUs.

When the Rx buffer is large enough for the next block (directly after the First Frame or the last Consecutive Frame of a block, or after repeated calls to PduR_CanTpCopyRxData () according to [SWS_CanTp_00222]), the CanTp module shall send a Flow Control N-PDU with ClearToSend status ( FC(CTS) ) and shall then expect the reception of Consecutive Frame N-PDUs.
